message:
How to Make a Wedding Guest List Without the Drama

Set your number before the names, then sort everyone into three tiers:
• immediate family and closest friends;
• extended family and good friends;
• coworkers and acquaintances.

Need to cut? Cut from the bottom. RSVPs low? Invite the next tier. Pick one rule each for plus-ones, kids and coworkers, and apply it to everyone.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/wedding-guest-list?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-04-noon-wedding-guest-list
